title.zh: 一台不关机的电脑，还不是一位可靠的同事
title.en: An always-on computer is not yet a dependable colleague

description.zh: 这周的 Personal Agent 产品有一个共同动作：把 AI 从一次对话里搬出来，放进一台持续在线的电脑。你离开之后，它还能整理文件、运行程序，等到指定时间再做下一件事。Founder Park 的文章把这轮变化梳理得很清楚：产品有的住在独立 App，有的通过短信和邮件出现，有的干脆是一支有名字的 Bot 团队；底层则逐渐收敛到云端电脑、长期记忆和外部工具连接。12
description.en: This week’s personal agents share a move: taking AI out of a single conversation and giving it a computer that stays online. After you leave, it can organize files, run programs and wake for a scheduled task. Founder Park surveys products living in apps, messages and email, or presented as teams of named bots. Underneath, their foundations increasingly resemble one another: a cloud computer, persistent memory and connections to other tools. 12

title.zh: 从“帮我管生活”，缩小到一件可以结束的事
title.en: Start with a task that can end

description.zh: Founder Park 提到退订服务这样的切口：任务有对象，也有明确结果。相比笼统的“管理我的生活”，我们更容易判断一项订阅是否取消、是否收到确认、下一期是否仍会扣款。真正让人愿意再次委托的，往往是这样一次完整的小闭环。
description.en: Founder Park points to cancelling subscriptions as a concrete entry point: there is an object and an observable outcome. Compared with “manage my life,” it is easier to check whether a subscription was cancelled, a confirmation arrived and the next bill stopped. One completed, bounded task can give a person a reason to delegate again.

title.zh: 团队规模之前，先把交接做一次
title.en: Before adding a team, complete one handoff

description.zh: 这周收藏的 Grok Bot 团队模板，把参谋长、功能负责人和验证者分开。公开配图里最有价值的设计，是提交工作的人不负责宣布自己验收通过；验证要指向可检查的产物，例如复现步骤、测试结果、截图或运行记录。原帖展示的是模板的一页，不能把它当成一套已经验证有效的完整组织方案。06
description.en: The saved Grok Bot team template separates a chief of staff, feature owners and verifiers. Its useful principle is that the producer cannot approve work merely by declaring it done. Verification should point to inspectable artifacts: a reproduction, test output, screenshots or a run record. The public image shows one template page, not evidence that an entire organizational system has been validated. 06

title.zh: 断线之后，别让“再来一次”成为默认答案
title.en: After a disconnect, “do it again” is not a sufficient recovery policy

description.zh: Pi 的 Durable Objects 教程提供了更底层的例子：把会话、任务和请求回执保存在持久状态里；请求重发时，先确认之前是否已经创建过对话；恢复检索时，找回原先的子任务。检索子代理还排除了过去的检索产物，避免一次摘要被下一轮当成原始证据。30
description.en: The Pi Durable Objects tutorial provides a lower-level example. It persists conversations, tasks and request receipts, checks repeated requests against previous work, and resumes the original retrieval subtask. The retrieval agent excludes previous retrieval outputs, reducing the risk of a summary becoming evidence for another summary. 30

title.zh: Scion：代码多了，最先吃紧的可能不是模型
title.en: Scion: the model may not be the first bottleneck

description.zh: Anthropic 的工程文章讲了一次很不寻常的基础设施改造。公司报告，单日合并次数从 5 月约 2,500 次升到 9 月超过 30,000 次，CI 每天约有 2,500 万次检出。在这个规模下，反复搬运历史和工作副本，成了实实在在的计算与网络负担。Scion 把更多历史查询、合并等工作放到服务端，客户端按需取得当前任务所需的数据。13
description.en: Anthropic describes an unusual infrastructure change. The company reports daily merges rising from roughly 2,500 in May to more than 30,000 in September, alongside about 25 million CI checkouts a day. Repeatedly moving history and working copies became a substantial compute and network burden. Scion moves more history queries and merge work to the server, while clients retrieve data needed for the current task. 13

title.zh: 让最短的路，就是正确的路
title.en: Make the easiest path the correct one

description.zh: @poteto 的原帖、以及这周收藏的中文解读，把信任 Agent 的投入顺序放在代码结构、自动检查、文字指导和人工审查上。我的理解是：与其反复提醒“这里不能这样改”，不如让接口、类型和模块边界尽早暴露这个错误。32
description.en: @poteto’s original post and the saved Chinese explanation prioritize code structure, automated checks, written guidance and human review. I read this as an argument for making interfaces, types and module boundaries expose recurring errors early, instead of repeatedly telling an agent not to make them. 32

title.zh: 状态、会话和记忆，分别留下什么？
title.en: Status, sessions and memory preserve different things

description.zh: Pi 1.1.0 的 Program Status Protocol 让终端知道程序正在工作、阻塞还是完成；Tern 把会话持久化与跨设备继续工作放到前台；Hy Memory 将聊天、工作和编码记忆区别对待。这三条产品阅读不必各写一篇长报告，却恰好补齐了交接中的三个位置。05 09 25
description.en: Pi 1.1.0’s Program Status Protocol communicates whether a program is working, blocked or finished. Tern emphasizes persistent sessions across devices. Hy Memory distinguishes chat, work and coding memory. These three product readings need not become three lengthy reports, but they occupy useful positions in a handoff. 05 09 25

title.zh: 周日补记：把需求也接进来
title.en: Sunday addendum: include the requirements

description.zh: 腾讯技术工程的文章，把 AI 研发从编码推进到需求澄清、技术方案、审查和知识沉淀。一个具体做法是对知识设置有效期，过期进入复核；如果 Agent 发现知识与当前代码冲突，再反馈给平台。比起知识库越来越大，这种“旧答案如何退场”的设计更值得带走。33
description.en: Tencent’s engineering article extends AI-assisted development into requirement clarification, technical design, review and organizational knowledge. One concrete mechanism assigns knowledge an expiry date and sends it for re-evaluation; agents can report contradictions with current code. How old answers retire is more useful than a growing knowledge count. 33

title.zh: IdeaScientist：让灵感有一条可追溯的来路
title.en: IdeaScientist: an idea should have a traceable origin

description.zh: 研究 Agent 容易把“提出很多想法”当成进展。IdeaScientist 把构思拆成找研究缺口、跨领域找相似问题的解法、形成提案三个角色，并用限定时间之前的文献，评估它提出的方向与后来人类论文的接近程度。论文链接与社区解读都保留在来源中。07 论文
description.en: Research agents can mistake a large volume of ideas for progress. IdeaScientist separates identifying gaps, retrieving analogous solutions from other fields and developing proposals. Its evaluation limits access to earlier literature and compares proposed directions with later human papers. The saved explanation and original paper remain linked. 07 Paper

title.zh: Evo²：改进工具的人，也开始学习
title.en: Evo²: the improver learns too

description.zh: Evo² 将两种改进放进循环：一边修改 Agent 的提示、工具和上下文组织方式，也就是 Harness；一边用这些修改及执行结果训练提出修改、诊断结果的模型。它的贡献在于把“改环境”和“改模型”连接起来，而不是又多了一份神奇提示词。20 论文
description.en: Evo² joins two changes in a loop: editing an agent’s prompts, tools and context organization—its harness—and using those edits and execution outcomes to train the model proposing and diagnosing changes. The contribution connects environmental improvement with model learning, rather than supplying another supposedly magical prompt. 20 Paper

title.zh: AI 研究 AI：解释必须能冒失败的风险
title.en: AI studying AI: explanations must risk being wrong

description.zh: 机器之心收藏介绍了 Nick Cammarata 的可解释性工作：先让 Agent 根据神经元响应提出解释，再让另一个 Agent 构造应当触发或不该触发的样本，交回网络测试。它改变的首先是研究规模——更多假设能被提出，也能被更快地反驳。27
description.en: The saved Synced article describes Nick Cammarata’s interpretability work: one agent proposes an explanation of a neuron, another constructs examples predicted to activate it—or not—and the network tests those predictions. The immediate change is the scale of investigation: more hypotheses can be proposed and challenged. 27

title.zh: 自复制与防蒸馏：别把不同层次的证据揉成一句话
title.en: Replication and distillation: separate levels of evidence

description.zh: Anthropic 的自复制研究测试了在不同设备建立推理的能力，也在简化环境中检验串联过程。局部步骤成功、受控流程成功、现实中的自主传播，是三个层次。论文中的简化访问条件不能在转述时被省去。11
description.en: Anthropic’s self-replication study tests setting up inference on different hardware and chaining capabilities in simplified environments. A successful component, a successful controlled sequence and autonomous spread in the real world are distinct claims. Simplified access conditions cannot disappear in the retelling. 11

title.zh: ExcaliClaw
title.en: ExcaliClaw

description.zh: 手绘图的协作工作区，支持保存、归档、分享和 MCP。把讨论留成可继续编辑的图。
description.en: A collaborative diagram workspace with storage, collections, sharing and MCP. Keep the discussion editable.

title.zh: magpie
title.en: magpie

description.zh: 一个本地网关，连接不同 Agent、模型与账号。路由过程可见，比单纯自动切换更有用。
description.en: One local gateway connects agents, models and accounts. Visible routing makes fallback easier to understand.

title.zh: mobile-mcp
title.en: mobile-mcp

description.zh: 通过可访问性树或截图坐标操作 iOS、Android 模拟器与真机，让 Agent 检查真实操作路径。
description.en: Operate iOS and Android simulators or real devices using accessibility trees or screenshot coordinates.

title.zh: Dots × Blender
title.en: Dots × Blender

description.zh: 作者用常驻电脑制作低多边形模型，并连接 Drive 保存产物。值得借鉴的是留下工程文件。
description.en: An author uses a persistent computer to make low-poly models and saves the output to Drive. Keep the working files.

description.zh: 这次更新把图像接进决策，新增 box 定位输出。下游程序可以接收位置，而不只是一段描述。
description.en: The update adds image input and box localization. A downstream program can receive a position rather than just prose.

title.zh: 聊天记录能带走，熟悉的回应呢？
title.en: You can take the transcript. Can you take the familiar reply?

description.zh: APPSO 的陪伴产品文章，从服务经营变化谈到一个容易被忽略的问题：导出聊天记录，只保存了过去发生过什么；下一次回答还依赖角色设定、基础模型、记忆选择和服务策略。本文关注这一产品问题，文中个别公司的破产与交易消息未经本刊独立核实，不作为本期新闻结论。17
description.en: APPSO’s companion-product article raises an overlooked problem through changes in service ownership and operation: a transcript records what already happened. The next reply depends on character settings, the base model, memory selection and service policies. This section considers that product question. Individual bankruptcy and transaction claims in the article have not been independently verified here and are not presented as this issue’s news findings. 17

title.zh: 当代码容易复现，产品还要留下什么？
title.en: When functionality is easier to reproduce, what remains?

description.zh: 卡兹克的文章把 AI 逆向成本下降，与软件壁垒和注意力联系起来。08 它的判断很鲜明；我的补充是，复现功能、可靠运行、让人继续使用，是三项不同的工作。入口可以模仿，旧数据如何迁移、异常由谁处理、用户是否相信下一次升级，这些问题并不会随着代码变便宜而消失。
description.en: Kazik’s article connects cheaper AI-assisted reverse engineering with software defenses and attention. 08 My addition is to distinguish reproducing a feature, operating it reliably and earning continued use. An interface can be imitated; migration, incident handling and confidence in the next upgrade do not disappear as code gets cheaper.

title.zh: 一份研究台，两条收益故事
title.en: One research desk, two return stories

description.zh: Opus 5.5 量化研究台的长指南，比标题里的“24/7”更有价值的，是它要求先固定研究对象、证据时间和计算规则。比如一家公司在不同市场有多个上市代码，不能不加处理就算成多家公司；今天才知道的信息，也不能放进过去的决策里。先把这些问题弄清，再让 AI 跑计算，结果才有可比较的意义。03
description.en: The long Opus 5.5 quant-research guide has something more valuable than its “24/7” headline: it asks the reader to fix the research universe, evidence timestamps and arithmetic rules first. A company with listings in several markets must not casually become several companies in the sample. Information learned today cannot enter a historical decision. Only after resolving those issues should AI computation produce comparable results. 03

title.zh: 周日补记：新人从哪里学会验收？
title.en: Sunday addendum: where do beginners learn to review?

description.zh: 新收录的 APPSO 文章讨论了 Anthropic 内部就业报告，并提出一个值得追问的矛盾：公司越来越强调判断力，但新人原本就是从小任务里的试错学会判断。这里是对该报道的阅读与推演，不能把一家公司的招聘变化直接当作整个行业的因果结论。34
description.en: A newly saved APPSO article discusses Anthropic’s internal employment report and a difficult tension: companies increasingly value judgment, yet beginners used to learn judgment through small tasks and mistakes. This is a reading and interpretation of that report, not a causal conclusion about the whole labor market from one company’s hiring changes. 34

title.zh: 最后，把“下次从这里开始”留给自己
title.en: Leave a starting point for tomorrow

description.zh: 李睿秋的生活小技巧里，有一条与本期意外相通：留下进度，让下一次开始有入口。01 我们自己也会遗忘昨天为什么停在这里。收工前记下做到哪儿、卡在哪儿、下一步是什么，既能帮同事和 Agent，也能帮明天的自己。
description.en: One of Lachel’s everyday suggestions connects unexpectedly with the issue: leave a progress note so the next session has an entry point. 01 People forget why they stopped yesterday too. Recording where the work stands, what is blocked and what comes next helps colleagues and agents—and tomorrow’s version of ourselves.
